evidence.detail: The class is abstract, extends R56 RSInterface, owns the shared TextDrawingArea[] font table, and requires one abstract no-arg build method while providing optional update/reset hooks and an enabled/retain predicate.
More than one hundred exact-v308 rs/n/c/* classes extend this base and implement their custom widget/interface construction in the abstract build hook.
Direct rs/n/d constructs each concrete subclass with the font table, invokes the base build hook through a(rs.n.c), and retains builders whose c() predicate returns true.
This is not the RSInterface widget object itself: R56 rs/n/e owns widget definitions, while this base coordinates code-built custom interface families on top of that widget table.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the abstract base shared by code-built custom interface definitions.

evidence.detail: The static bootstrap method clears its retained builder list, stores the shared TextDrawingArea[] font table, then constructs and registers the complete exact-v308 rs/n/c/* custom-interface family in one deterministic sequence.
Registration method a(rs.n.c) invokes each builder's build hook and retains the builder only when its c() predicate returns true.
After all builders are constructed and run, the bootstrap calls the RSInterface static finalization/setup path with the same font table.
Client and other live interface code reference this class directly; it also exposes reset behavior that clears Client.cH and resets shared interface helper state.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the static bootstrap/registry that instantiates and executes the entire custom-interface builder catalogue.
